concern_results.conclusion: Test files now only count as registered when they appear in runner commands. Leading env assignments and `env` are skipped, and token scanning stops at -c/-e. Sealed archives are now pinned in code, and a file is skipped only if both its own hash and its MANIFEST.json entry match. The four-character IP_LINE_PREFIXES tuple is behavior-equivalent to the previous inline literals.

Challenge item 1 is closed: an author-added MANIFEST.json no longer exempts a .py file, because only the in-code allowlist (capped at 1) is honored. host-smoke.sh now unsets every GIT_* variable. No new write paths.

A shlex ValueError still returns an empty set, so an unparsable line registers nothing and the check fails closed. An unreadable or malformed manifest makes the archive check return False, so the file is compiled with warnings as errors. An archive path that is no longer tracked is reported as stale.

The tests now cover echo/ls/test-only mentions, a self-sealed unapproved manifest, all 256x256 leading-octet IP_RE prefix pairs, and GIT_* poison plus an untracked-file canary asserted inside the stub npm. Each would fail if the risky behavior came back. Minor gap: the clean-repo test no longer runs run_all_checks end to end with the default allowlist.
The new check_python_warnings keyword argument is optional and defaults to the in-code allowlist. CLI output tokens are unchanged. Scope stays within the Batch A follow-up items.
Changes are limited to gate scripts and tests and can be reverted with git revert. No migration or published artifact is involved.
New findings for an exceeded cap and a stale archive are reported through display(). The stub prints a clear diagnostic and exits 9 when GIT_* variables leak.

The 'exhaustive' claim holds for leading octet pairs, and the IP_RE alternatives depend only on those octets. The mutation count changed from 16 to 19 to match the evidence; that number is the author's claim and is not verifiable from this diff.
The shared-gate bypass through self-sealed manifests is removed, and the hard-coded allowlist size is capped at 1. host-smoke isolation is strengthened by scrubbing all GIT_* variables.
Consistent with packages/ccl-skills-npm/scripts/AGENTS.md (scrub ambient GIT_*, stage only tracked files) and scripts/AGENTS.md. No contract file is loosened.
